process_observations.observation: Both EmailTemplate meta XMLs written by the cut-off session carry exactly the eight elements the cited reference's worked template documents - available, description, encodingKey, name, style, subject, type, uiType - in the same order, with no element outside that set; re-verification changed nothing.

Two consumer skills' worked examples reference the same developer names this step builds under the shared unfiled folder - escalation-rules metadata-examples.md:95 writes unfiled$public/Case_Escalated_To_Tier2 and assignment-rules metadata-examples.md:148/:159 write unfiled$public/Case_Web_Acknowledgement - so copying either example verbatim into M4-S04 or M3-S04 produces a template reference that resolves to nothing in an org where these templates live in case_intake.

M3-S03 declares depends_on M3-S02 but none of its declared outputs references a template of this step; the element that looks as though it should, webToCase.defaultResponseTemplate, is documented as not being the acknowledgement email (case-management-setup metadata-examples.md:407-412 scopes it to Self-Service portal responses) and is deliberately omitted there.
